Class PreBuildTeamController

java.lang.Object
controllers.Controller<PreBuildTeamView>
controllers.PreBuildTeamController
public class PreBuildTeamController extends Controller<PreBuildTeamView>
Controller for the team management screen. Handles creating, renaming, deleting and modifying saved teams.
